driver.text: US futures are modestly higher after Friday's selloff (Dow down 600+ points) as President Trump ruled out an immediate US attack on Iran and oil eased (WTI about $101.3, Brent about $110.1, both down ~1.4-1.9%). Investors are bracing for a heavy earnings week and the Fed decision Wednesday at 2 p.m. ET (CME FedWatch ~90.6% odds of no change; a 'hawkish pause' is possible after hotter inflation data). AI stocks have struggled to rebound after last week's selloff. Itau Unibanco is down ~28% premarket after Lula won Brazil's election.

items.headline: Coinbase CFO says Circle agreement 'will renew on the same terms'; record $20B average USDC held in Coinbase products
items.summary: A Coinbase Q3 preview notes the USDC revenue-share agreement with Circle is expected to renew unchanged, a modest positive for CRCL's distribution economics. Bitcoin slipping to ~$80K and softer crypto trading volume are sentiment risks; Coinbase reports Oct 29 after the close, a read-through for stablecoin and crypto activity.

items.headline: Ether near $2,320 as US spot ether ETFs are on pace for about $1.18B of October outflows; Glamsterdam test delayed
items.summary: Per Farside Investors data cited by Crypto Times, spot ether ETFs have had net inflows on only three of 17 October sessions, and BlackRock's ETHA accounts for most of the selling. Separately, core developers postponed the Glamsterdam upgrade on the Hoodi testnet (set for Oct 26) to study EIP-8037; no mainnet date is set. Continued outflows and a delayed upgrade weigh on ETH sentiment ahead of Wednesday's Fed decision.

items.headline: AI bear slams Nvidia's GPU pitch: 'There's not scarcity other than that which is created by Jensen Huang'

Full article text was not retrieved, so details are limited to the headline.

items.headline: Wall Street weighs SpaceX earnings and a likely Tesla tie-up; Canaccord lifts Tesla target to $442
items.summary: After SpaceX's better-than-expected quarter, strategists are treating a SpaceX-Tesla combination as likely, though no deal is announced (special committees formed; a SpaceX filing said no determination has been made). Canaccord raised its Tesla target to $442 from $410 on a merger scenario; Yorkville's Dan Ives sees an 80-90% chance of a deal by end-2027. Tesla closed Friday at $372.22 (-0.63%). Merger headlines are a swing factor for TSLA; deal terms and dilution are unknown.

items.headline: Alphabet down ~1% premarket ahead of Wednesday earnings alongside Microsoft; AI spending and backlogs in focus
items.summary: GOOG was down 1.08% in Yahoo's premarket snapshot. Alphabet and Microsoft report Wednesday (Oct 28), and investors are weighing rising AI capex and cloud backlogs after last week's AI selloff; the Fed decision lands the same afternoon. A cloud-growth or capex surprise is the main catalyst for the stock this week.
